description: The raw reports of a channel, with the address. Operator only (METRICS_TOKEN). Use it to investigate one channel. In the current reports, the `ip` field has an identifier calculated from the network and a secret value. The retention period is in `retention_days`. The public panel does not return this identifier.

limit.description: Items per page. A value above 50 becomes 50.

ok.description: `0` returns only the failures, which is the subset for an investigation.

name: play_reports
title: Raw play reports
